title: A photorealistic cinematic vertical full
prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic vertical full-body portrait of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing on an outdoor tennis court during late afternoon or early evening under a clear pale-blue sky. Her specific ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has smooth light-toned skin, a softly tapered oval face, a delicate jawline, a small refined nose, natural lips, and dark expressive eyes. Her eyebrows are straight and softly defined. Her expression is calm, focused, and slightly serious as she looks downward toward the low-positioned camera.

Her dark brown to black hair is tied into a long low ponytail falling behind her shoulder and down her back, with straight wispy bangs across her forehead and a few loose strands blowing horizontally across her face in the breeze. She stands in a relaxed athletic pose with her torso turned slightly toward the camera, hips angled subtly to one side, and both hands holding a tennis racket in front of her body. One hand grips the lower handle while the other rests higher along the grip, positioning the racket diagonally upward toward the upper-left portion of the frame. Her legs are straight and naturally spaced, emphasizing the low-angle perspective.

She wears exactly a fitted white short-sleeve collared tennis polo shirt tucked neatly into a bright light-blue pleated tennis skirt. The skirt is short, structured, and dramatically flared outward with crisp accordion pleats, revealing dark fitted athletic safety shorts underneath. She also wears white ribbed knee-high athletic socks and light-colored tennis shoes partially visible near the bottom edge of the frame. Do not add jackets, accessories, hats, jewelry, or additional layers.

Photograph her from a very low ground-level perspective using approximately a 24–28mm wide-angle lens, creating elongated legs and a strong upward view while keeping natural human proportions. The foreground shows the green outer tennis-court surface transitioning into a blue playing area, with a tennis net stretching across the middle distance. Several colorful tennis balls are scattered across the far court. On the left side, include a black wheeled tennis-ball basket/cart and a partially visible person near the court edge. In the distance are chain-link fencing, low sports structures, trees, and several urban apartment buildings.

Use soft backlighting from the low sun behind the subject, producing gentle rim light around her silhouette, subtle atmospheric haze, slightly cool shadows, realistic skin translucency, and restrained cinematic contrast. Natural blue-and-cyan color grading, authentic outdoor exposure, subtle lens flare, fine photographic detail, realistic fabric texture, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, candid sports-fashion editorial atmosphere, highly photorealistic, no artificial beauty-filter effect. Aspect ratio 9:16.
